notes.title: Maintenance Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
We just released minor update. New in version 1.7.0:

 Updated game engine
 SDL2 updated to version 2.0.9
 Multiple minor fixes
 Improved Default theme, now with snowflakes! :)


We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
Starwind Games Team

We want to say thank you to people who helped us:

 Lawlss for Turkish translation (http://steamcommunity.com/id/lawlss)
 Samuele Canina for Italian translation
 Daimon Blaise for Polish translation
 and CZPortal4Gamers for Czech translation


We also glad to announce that our new logical game, Dwarflings, was just greenlit and soon will be released.

Thanks for your support and feedback!
Starwind Games Team

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Patch 1.4.2
notes.notes:
New update is available for download!

Improvements

 Markers option added, you can turn it on to see symbolic markers on dots (this will help to distinguish dots of the same color and different brightness levels);
 Fixed bug which caused high CPU usage (4-6 times lesser now). Thanks to @ecramer for the report.


Thanks for following and waiting for your feedback!
Starwind Games Team

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
New update is ready for download. There are many small fixes, both code and visuals. We also enabled Steam Leaderboards, so you can compare your score with other players.

Thanks to all of you for feedback and bug reports. Since the release date we added new skins and fixed all significant problems.

Starwind Games Team

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Patch 1.1.8 (Windows only)
notes.notes:
Good news! First patch is here. Please check change log below:

What's new?

 New Nature skin (lighter skin)


http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=766759891

Fixes and improvements

 Improved skin selection, now you can see full preview, including buttons
 Fixed broken 12x12 - level 19 (unreachable cell)
 Fixed lag on sound volume change
 Fixed background animations bug during game
 Fixed buttons position in main menu


Thanks for following, new update is coming within few days. We planning to release Mac OS version and to add more skins.

Please let us know if you found a bug.

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Release
notes.notes:
Dots eXtreme is ready for release on Steam! If you like challenging puzzles then we invite you to test your skills.

Next big milestone on our road map is built-in level editor, which will be released in form of free update.

Thank you for your interest.

Starwind Games Team
